prompt: As of January 1st, 2024, how many buildings in New York City were 750ft or taller the last time Halley's Comet came close to Earth?
answer:
As of Halley’s Comet’s last close return in **1986**, New York City had **11 buildings at least 750 feet tall**.

They included the Twin Towers of the World Trade Center, the Empire State Building, Chrysler Building, 40 Wall Street, 70 Pine Street, Woolworth Building, 30 Rockefeller Plaza, MetLife Building, Citicorp Center, and One Chase Manhattan Plaza.
